checks.name: pending real-image measurement holds both consumers and uses only the new OCR boundary
real verifier projects retained prices for two shared SVG views without granting semantic authority
valid model bounds with false quality still grant no pattern or liquidity authority
identity revocation removes all placements synchronously
reconfirming the same source waits for a fresh measurement
a changed confirmation object invalidates the current image and report measurement
a late old-report response is ignored even when the controlled transport ignores abort
image A to B to A never revives an old image result
revocation during a pending read blocks its completion after reconfirmation
explicit logarithmic scale holds before either OCR reader
malformed scale limitations hold before either OCR reader
a malformed candidate authority envelope holds before either OCR reader
ambiguous touching panels publish a terminal hold without invoking OCR
an over-budget original image holds before canvas readback and OCR
an explicit independent OCR hold cannot reuse earlier placements
a rejected independent read remains held without authority widening
nonlinear controlled OCR words fail the real axis verifier in the mounted flow
a bare verified-axis envelope cannot grant source placement
removing a shared view neither restarts OCR nor creates a render loop
unmount aborts a pending read and ignores its later completion
no browser exceptions, legacy reader calls or external requests occurred

limitations: Synthetic public chart rasters and controlled OCR boundary; this checks mounted binding and authority behavior, not real OCR/scanner accuracy or physical-device latency.
